name: Inverclyde
title: Inverclyde —
title_em: the lower Clyde and the Cut.
tagline: Greenock, Gourock and the sweep of the Firth of Clyde.
summary: Inverclyde is on the south side of the Clyde estuary, with Greenock, Gourock and Port Glasgow. Greenock was a shipbuilding and sugar town and the birthplace of James Watt.
Ferries from Gourock link to the Cowal peninsula, and the Greenock Cut is a historic aqueduct with views over the Clyde.
